description: Chart 15 — The theory, tested directly. One dot per SA2 (≥5 venues in the 2023 cohort): transport access (share of venues within 400 m of a stop, x) against two-year venue survival (y), coloured metro (teal) / regional (orange), dot size = cohort size. A linear trend per region makes the answer visible: the slope is flat-to-slightly-negative — more transport access does NOT predict more venues staying open. Mirrors the hero scatter (chart-06) deliberately: same idiom, opposite expectation. Survival is a licence-presence proxy; association only. Data: chart_sa2_survival.csv.

title.text: More transport access, no better survival
title.subtitle: Each dot is an SA2. The trend lines are flat-to-downward — proximity to transport doesn't predict which venues last.
